parameters.content:
## New listing -> a cinematic property reel, automatically

Every morning this workflow takes the first listing in your sheet that has no
Status yet, turns its photos into a 1080x1920 reel (~19 s) with Zvid, writes
the finished video URL back to that row and marks it done.

The reel opens on the hero photo with a slow cinematic zoom, walks the rest of
the photos one at a time - each spotlighting one fact (beds / baths / sq ft) -
and closes on an agent card with a portrait, phone and CTA.

### Setup (about three minutes)

1. **Zvid API key** - create one at https://app.zvid.io/api-keys
   Add an n8n **Header Auth** credential: name `x-api-key`, value = your key.
   Attach it to *Validate project (free)*, *Save draft to editor*,
   *Submit render* and *Get render status*.
2. **Google Sheets** - attach your Google credential to *Read listings sheet*
   and *Mark listing done*, then pick your spreadsheet and tab in both nodes.
   The expected columns are in the yellow note next to the sheet node.
3. **Open `Config`** - set `brandName` (your brokerage), `contactUrl` and the
   two brand colours.
4. **Run it - the first run renders for real and spends about 20 credits.**
   `dryRun` is `false` out of the box. When it finishes, click
   **> Watch video** to play the reel right here in n8n.
5. Want a free preview first? Set `dryRun: true` in **Config**: you get the
   credit quote plus an **editorLink** to watch the video in the editor,
   nothing spent and the sheet untouched. Set it back to `false` to render.
6. **Activate** - one listing goes out per day at 9am.

## Your sheet: one row per listing

Header row (row 1), spelled exactly like this:

| Address | City | Price | Beds | Baths | Sqft | Photo1 | Photo2 | Photo3 | Photo4 | Photo5 | AgentName | AgentPhone | AgentPhotoUrl | Status | VideoUrl |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

- **Address** and **at least two Photo cells** are required - everything else
  is optional and the layout closes up when it is missing.
- **Photo1** is the hero shot; Photo2..Photo5 become one scene each (5 photos
  max, extra ones are ignored).
- **Price / Sqft** - type plain numbers (`749000`, `2840`) and the builder
  formats them (`$749,000`, `2,840`). Anything you type that already has a
  symbol or a suffix is printed exactly as typed.
- **AgentPhotoUrl** - optional. Empty gets a designed monogram disc instead.
- **Status** - leave EMPTY for listings waiting to be rendered. The workflow
  takes the first empty-Status row (top to bottom) and writes `done` + the
  video URL when the render finishes. Put anything in Status by hand to skip
  a row.

## What the build step actually does

*Build project JSON* is the whole design - no LLM, no template service.

- **Smooth cinematic zoom** on every photo. `kenBurnsDepth` (Config, default
  `1.14`) is the push at the end of a scene; consecutive scenes alternate
  between the full push and a gentler one, and alternate the wipe direction
  and the side the type sits on, so no two scenes in a row look the same.
- **One fact per scene.** Beds, baths and sq ft rotate through the photo
  scenes as an oversized numeral, with the other two on a muted rail beneath.
  Only facts your row actually carries are used - nothing is invented, nothing
  is rounded. A row with no beds/baths/sqft shows the price there instead.
- **Type scales with content.** A short address sets at 76 px; a 70-character
  one steps down to 46 px and re-flows onto two lines, and the price banner
  above it moves with it. Long agent names shrink the same way.
- **Photos are center-cropped to 9:16** (`cover`, never stretched), and the
  scrims are calibrated so the type clears 4.5:1 on a white kitchen as well
  as on a dusk exterior.
- Every value that comes from your sheet is HTML-escaped before it reaches
  the layout.

## Free preview: the optional dry run

**`dryRun` is `false` in Config, so a run renders for real.** Set it to
`true` whenever you want a free pass instead: the workflow validates the
payload, quotes the exact credit cost and saves the project as a **draft**,
then reports an **editorLink** like `https://editor.zvid.io/?project=prj_...`

Open it to watch the exact video and tweak anything by hand, with nothing
spent. **The sheet row is not marked done on a dry run**, so the next real
run renders the same listing.

Set `dryRun` back to `false` to render and mark the row done.

## Sheet today, your CRM tomorrow

`source` in Config picks the branch:

- **`"sheet"`** (default) - the Google Sheet above.
- **`"airtable"`** - set `airtableBaseId` (the `app...` id in your Airtable
  URL), `airtableTable` and optionally `airtableView`, then attach a
  **Bearer Auth** credential holding an Airtable personal access token to
  *Fetch Airtable listings*. Field names match the sheet headers.

Airtable mode is **read-only**: rendered record ids are remembered in workflow
static data so the same listing is not re-rendered, but nothing is written
back. Add an HTTP Request `PATCH` node after *Run summary* if you want the
video URL written into the record.

**Real MLS data?** Point *Fetch Airtable listings* at any JSON feed that
returns records with these fields - a SimplyRETS sandbox, your IDX provider,
or your own API - and adjust *Pick Airtable listing* to match its shape.

**Keep the copy factual.** The reel prints only the numbers in your row plus
the labels in Config. Fair-housing rules apply to listing marketing: do not
put subjective or demographic language into `listedLabel`, `ctaText` or the
address fields.

## Publishing the video (optional tail)

The workflow ends with the video URL in the sheet - a clean handoff you can
extend after **Mark listing done**:

- **YouTube Shorts** - add an *HTTP Request* node (GET the `videoUrl`,
  response format `File`) followed by the native **YouTube** node
  (Video -> Upload, binary `data`). Needs a YouTube OAuth2 credential.
- **Instagram / TikTok / Facebook** - pass `videoUrl` to a scheduler like
  Blotato, Buffer or Metricool over their HTTP API; they accept a public
  video URL directly, no download step needed.
- **The agent** - a Slack or Email node that sends `videoUrl` to whoever
  posts it, or straight to the seller.

They are left out of the required path on purpose so the template imports and
runs with a Zvid key and a Google account, nothing else.

## > Watch video

Click this node after a run: n8n renders the downloaded MP4 as an inline
video player with a download button - today's listing reel, no URL to copy.

*Run summary* before it still carries `videoUrl` (and `jobId`,
`creditsCharged`) if you want to pipe the result onward.
